Diego / Sarah —
I checked VP calendars. Two options for executive sponsor presence:

- Oct 27, 10:00–11:00 PT: VP Product (Elaine Park) + Head of Ops (if we want infra coverage).
- Oct 28, 14:00–15:00 PT: VP GTM (Ibrahim Khan) only — better for business-case focus.

If ACME wants a mix of infra + product signals, Oct 27 is the safer bet. I attached a short note on recommended agenda sequencing for that slot so we can keep the EB to 45 minutes + 15 for Q/A.

Ben, Sarah — please confirm which slot you prefer and Ben, drop the updated MAP with gate definitions so procurement has the artifact to include with the SOW review.

Attachments: EB_slot_reco.txt (txt)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP v3 + evaluation gate criteria

Sarah —
Attached is MAP_v3.pdf with the Oct 27 EB slot baked into Gate 2. I added an explicit eval checklist for the proof-of-inference:

- Quality: 3 prompt sets, median response appropriateness >= 85% (as measured by your rubric)
- Latency: p95 inference latency <= 350ms for 512 tokens (baseline infra)
- Cost: 20% lower per-token cost vs current hosted baseline (projected)
- Security: KV cache and network egress policy documented (SOC2 artifacts linked)

I've also appended a redlines doc (track changes) for the SOW timelines so procurement can see expected SOW sign-off by Oct 20 to enable provisioning.

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf, MAP_v3_track_changes.pdf

Let me know if anything needs to move — otherwise I'll circulate the calendar invite once Sarah confirms the slot.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
